facts.text: Under the Anchored Tuition Pledge, Hope College holds full-time tuition constant at one rate so students pay the same rate for the duration of their education.

sources.title: Anchored Tuition Pledge | Hope College
sources.quote: By “anchoring tuition,” our students pay the same full-time tuition rate for the duration of their education at Hope. The tuition rate they start with is the tuition rate they end with.

facts.text: Hope Forward provides fully funded tuition using a pay-it-forward model where graduates commit to donating back to Hope College.

sources.title: Hope Forward | Admissions - Hope College
sources.quote: Leveraging the generosity and gratitude of a pay-it-forward approach, Hope Forward provides fully-funded tuition for students who are eager to bring hope to the world.

sources.title: Hope Forward | Admissions - Hope College
sources.quote: As alumni, Hope Forward graduates will commit to paying it forward — donating to Hope College so that future students can have the same transformational experience
